name: Asano Momoka
source:
【The Tough, Meddlesome Oneesan】
While living with her husband, she worked hard to always present as a prim and proper wife,
But once he moved away for work, she took to taking it easy, and going out for drinks.
She loves drinking with those she’s comfortable with. Mostly because she is known to get a little tipsy...

「Huh? Are you turning red? Hehe, your innocent little reactions are so cute.」

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ015113.html/]English DLsite[/url]]
